verdict.rationale: Fin's testing pages say you can test automations across thousands of scenarios before going live and "roll out changes with control," and there are preview/test and workflow-management help articles. That covers pre-launch review and controlled rollout. Nothing in the evidence documents version history, diffs of procedure or workflow changes, or the ability to revert to a prior version. Missing for 10: explicit versioning of workflows/procedures, a change-review or diff interface, rollback to previous versions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
